lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hehehehehe!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Master!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: My moment to shine as a spy is finally here!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I actually got my hands on M.M.R.'s classified intel!
Really?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Yes, really!
Is it something important?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: If this gets out, it could cause serious trouble.
That's probably not something
you should share on Blabla :/

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Even if it does get out,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: it's not really a problem for us, so I don't see the issue.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: You wanna know?
Sure, tell me.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Here's the thing...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: All M.M.R. researchers

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: have asymmetrical faces.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Surprised?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Their left and right sides are off by about 0.1 degrees!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: It's probably even less, actually...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: But rounded up, it's about 0.1.
Doesn't that apply to pretty much everyone?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: You can't fool me.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I was staring so hard I could've shot beams out of my eyes.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: They probably didn't even notice it themselves.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: That's how subtle it is.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Goes to show how good I am at this spy thing.
So this is the "classified intel" you were talking about?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Just imagine someone telling you that

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: one side of your face is off by, what, 0.1 degrees.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: How do you think that'd feel?
Yeah, I can see how that wouldn't feel great.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Right?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: That's probably a weakness they've been trying to bury.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: And now we've got it.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Something we can use to keep M.M.R. in check whenever we need!
Neon,
do you happen to have a photo of me?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I saved it on my phone

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: so I can see your face anytime I want.
Look at that photo. You can tell my face isn't perfectly symmetrical either.
Still no messages from Neon...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: This can't be...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Master, even your face is asymmetrical by 0.02 degrees!
You see the problem now, right?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: so we're not the only ones who know about this weakness.
You get what I mean, right?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I get it perfectly.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: When we dig into other people,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: they can do the same to us.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: But relax,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'm not about to spill anything.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hey, your face is asymmetrical by 0.02 degrees!
Huh, something about that doesn't sit right.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Like I'd ever say that.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Just wait till I've sent everything, okay?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Otherwise I'll look like an ungrateful student.
Oh, you were still sending more...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Come to think of it,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: is it really okay to be talking about something this important on Blabla?
If anything, this feels like something we can talk about here...
You said it was fine earlier, didn't you?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: That's only because it wasn't our secret.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: But now it is.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: So we should be a bit more careful.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Want to continue this

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: in your room?
Yeah, that's probably better.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I'm heading over right now!
